title: 長文入力の全画面編集
source: User mobile UI feedback: long-text fields such as 本文 and 目的 are difficult to read in compact textareas and should open fullscreen when tapped.
problem: Long-form text in the item/project editing UI had insufficient reading and editing area on mobile.

behavior: Tap or click a standard long-text textarea to open a fullscreen dialog.
Use 100vw x 100dvh with safe-area padding on mobile.
Show the source field label in the fullscreen header.
Synchronize edits back to the original textarea while editing and again when closing.
Return through the 編集画面へ戻る button, Escape, or backdrop without losing the current value.
Exclude JSON/code textareas from fullscreen behavior.
implementation.coverageNote: The generic selector applies to standard .field textareas, including similarly rendered project long-text fields. Automated acceptance explicitly verifies 本文 and 理由・根拠.

stageB.note: The first attempt passed product/UI and ten-scenario checks but its immediate final GitHub Contents read observed the previous successful writer after a retry PUT. Re-running the same job without code changes passed the CAS race/retry verification.

blocker: This UX change does not alter the existing C-03 human decision requirement. D-01 remains blocked until explicit maxSyncMs, maxRecalculationMs, and approvalRef are supplied.
